results.title: India Successfully Conducts Maiden Flight-Test of Kusha Long-Range Surface-to-Air Missile
results.description: India successfully conducts the maiden flight-test of Kusha Long-Range Surface-to-Air Missile from APJ Abdul Kalam Island, intercepting a simulated high-speed, high-altitude target.

results.title: Shaann Carriers to get Compliance Certificate
results.description: Labour Commissioner Givens Muntengwa, has committed the issuance of a compliance certificate to Shaann Carriers, after being compliant with labour laws in the country. Speaking during a joint tour in Lusaka West, Mr Muntengwa, said Shaann Carriers has been identified as a possible benchmark which can be emulated by other companies in the logistics business. [...]
